title: Tool inventory
description: The shape of docs/reference/tools/inventory.yaml. The Documentation.Auditor validates the file against this schema, then applies the rules a schema cannot express (ADR-0023). The tool-doc-author skill adds entries to match it.

last-verified.description: When the versions, licenses, and sources of the entries were last checked against their primary sources.

id.description: The stable ID. A tool page is named after it, and the tools list in a page's front matter uses it.

tier.description: How much documentation the tool needs (docs/reference/tools/index.md). A tool on hold has the tier n/a.

usage.description: Where the tool is in practice. A tool becomes in-use in the work package that first runs it.

introduced.description: The phase that introduced the tool, or n/a for a tool that was only evaluated.

version.description: The version that was verified. A pin lives in Directory.Packages.props, .config/dotnet-tools.json, or the file that uses the tool, and the auditor compares them.

sources.description: Primary sources for the version, the license, and the documentation.

adrs.description: The numbers of the ADRs that concern the tool.

notes.description: Why the license is acceptable when it is not permissive (ADR-0004), and any caveat that a reader needs.

detect.description: How the auditor finds the tool in the repository, each as kind:pattern. The kinds are nuget (a package ID), dotnet-tool (a tool package ID), action (owner/repo), image (a repository without its tag), and file (a glob). A trailing * matches any ending.
